text: Git branching is an important part of version control. A branch lets you work on new ideas without changing the main code. Developers often create feature branches to build and test new features safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Before merging, teams usually open a pull request so others can review the changes and leave comments. This workflow keeps the project organized and reduces mistakes. It also helps teams work together, because everyone can develop in parallel and combine their work step by step.
